label: PF Backlog 653
title: Execution trail: one ordered flow view (plain language, Gate 0, stage checklist, 1.5/2.5 tables, decisions, tests, final)

decisions.note: HIL instruction: continue (flow-view wiring). Design approved with attention: fleet observability accepted as out of scope; flow view is read-only CLI.

brief.problem: Gates are wired but the flow is scattered; the HIL sees file edits and stage rows, not the item story or where it is.
brief.what_adds: One ordered flow view from plain language -> Gate 0 -> checks -> 1.5/2.5 tables -> decisions -> tests -> final.
brief.why_now: The HIL cannot follow the process without manually running several tools.
brief.success: One command shows the whole item story and current stage, with disposition semantics.

objective: Make the execution trail show one ordered end-to-end flow per item so the HIL can see what an item is, why it exists, every gate/review/decision, where it is now, and the final result without piecing together scripts.
acceptance_criteria: python -m core.execution_trail show --item <ID> renders one ordered flow: plain-language brief (problem/what/why/who/success), Gate 0 reconciliation + impact table, a flow checklist with the current stage, Gate 1.5 table + recommendation, Gate 1 decision, implementation/code-review summary, Gate 2.5 table + recommendation, Gate 2 decision, tests, usage/cost and the final completion/next-item table.

Stage status uses the latest event per stage (re-run duplicates are not shown in the checklist), review stages show the current architect recommendation (APPROVE / APPROVE WITH ATTENTION / NOT READY) instead of the ingest-time event status, and a disposition key explains ACTIONED/ACCEPTED/DEFERRED/REJECTED/SCOPE (DEFERRED must cite a follow-up backlog id).
Tests cover section order, current-stage derivation, re-run dedupe, review recommendation display, the disposition key and partial/empty items; existing trail/check tests still pass; precheck passes.
in_scope: Execution trail: one ordered flow view (plain language, Gate 0, stage checklist, 1.5/2.5 tables, decisions, tests, final)
out_of_scope: No new trail/store/writer or gate changes.
No migration; append-only history is unchanged.
No fleet metrics (accepted as a CLI trade-off).
approach: Extend core/execution_trail.py:show into one ordered read-only flow: brief, Gate 0 reconciliation/impact, current-stage checklist, Gate 1.5/2.5 tables + current recommendation, Gate 1/2 decisions, implementation/code review, tests, usage, final, disposition key. Derive status from the latest event per stage; render missing evidence explicitly.

assumptions: The flow view is a read-only projection over the existing trail + backlog item; no new store.
No HTTP API change; the CLI is the owner surface for this view.
Review status is derived from the current evidence/dispositions, not the ingest-time event status.
Current stage is the first required STAGES entry with no committed event.
Disposition semantics: ACTIONED=fixed/committed now; ACCEPTED=risk accepted, not fixed; DEFERRED=not fixed + backlog id; REJECTED=invalid; SCOPE=another owner.
divergences: None: extends the existing BI-PF-1481 viewer; no duplicate trail writer or store.

sig:1c6a0f2ed1fcb5d1.note: Design names the owner and files: core/execution_trail.py:show is the only renderer; tests + docs. No second flow renderer. affected_files/affected_components/out_of_scope set on the item.

sig:830f9524bc13eb7d.note: Boundary set: no HTTP API/UI/JSON mode, no new store or writer, no gate/tooling changes and no migration; only the existing show output changes.

sig:27d299834de098cf.note: Disposition data is owned by core.backlog.review_dispositions; statuses are validated by architect_review.py; DEFERRED-requires-follow-up is enforced by execution_trail_check.py; the flow view only renders the key. Documented.

sig:05a54b15376ce245.note: Latest = last event in append order under the trail lock; seq is monotonic. show shows the latest per stage and a Runs count; test_current_stage_and_latest_event_wins covers re-runs.

sig:a6e7c3f52134bee9.note: The review JSON is read by the sha in the design_review event refs; missing/unreadable evidence renders 'not recorded'/'evidence missing', never a pass; the recommendation is parsed from architect_review.py gate. Documented.

sig:24623ce928e5e98f.note: current_stage = first STAGES entry with no committed event; empty -> planning; all -> complete. Covered by tests; skipped stages remain the current stage.

sig:0162bdebd113f695.note: Read-only CLI; no metric/log sink. Missing evidence is explicit in the output and write failures hit the trail failure sink. Fleet observability is out of scope for this item.

sig:616d671de70a76da.note: Pure read-model over the append-only trail; revert changes rendering only; no migration, no writes, no destructive step.

sig:df45e9ff5580a254.note: Cells wrap at 44 chars and tables are sectioned; no pager. Accepted as a CLI usability trade-off.

sig:fb2f0d24a37895dc.note: show performs no writes to the trail or check state; all writes stay with the existing owners (gate tools/backlog/precheck).

sig:d07c603b4adff2a9.note: Authz/RLS/tenant/API are not applicable to a local read-only CLI; the API CHECK row records needs_api=false. Documented in the design.
